title: Use Group B: Amusement and entertainment-enhancing uses
previewText:
Use Group B consists of a group of uses, selected from Use Groups VI, VIII and X, as modified in this Section:

From Use Group VI

Eating or drinking establishments, without size limitations

From Use Group VIII

All uses listed under Art Galleries and Studios

All uses listed under Other Assembly Spaces

From Use Group X

Breweries, included under all other beverage manufacturing.
